tests: tests/test_mpv_system_dv_series.py checks the patch's level semantics textually: the per-render frame read, the successful-map-only true value, clearing at the frame-queue reset and generation change, and notification on change.
limits: Compilation and linking only. No package build, no runtime, IPC or display test of the patched player.
The level reports what libplacebo passes as enhancement_layer_composed for the last frame read in a presented render. With frame mixing, that is the newest frame of the mix.
It does not distinguish a full enhancement layer from a minimal one.
The +rogdv5.7 package build, its installation on the ROG and the attended check are owner-coordinated.
